data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kh-h-l', meaning 'to be pure, to purify, and to be elegant'. Kahhalah is a beautiful and elegant name for a Muslim girl. The name Kahhalah carries the meaning “Elegant, Pure, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kahhalah usually hope their child will grow to embody elegant, pure, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
